mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) level indicates accommodative monetary policy, which reduces the cost of capital and increases equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 4.5%) indicates a weak labor market, which typically leads to monetary policy easing and increased government spending, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 2.0%) and elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL > 245) signals a 'Goldilocks' economy with growth and stable inflation, which supports equity valuations and produces positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 2.0 and CPIAUCSL > 245.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%), a decline in the unemployment rate signals improving labor market conditions, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of housing starts (HOUST > 1300) signals robust consumer demand and economic expansion, which increases corporate earnings expectations and produces positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when HOUST > 1300.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 105) signals a weakening economy, which typically leads to monetary stimulus and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when INDPRO < 105.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising housing starts (HOUST > 1280) and strong retail sales (RSAFS > 490000) signals robust consumer demand, which increases corporate earnings expectations and produces positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when HOUST > 1280 and RSAFS > 490000.

mechanism_narrative: A high inflation rate (CPIAUCSL > 250) signals potential monetary tightening, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 250.
